none: PAS NLM-2A2F82: Roman Coin: Denarius of Faustina II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. Denarius of Faustina II (147-175), as identified by the finder, Reece period 8, mint of Rome, RIC volume 3 no. 688. Obverse description: Bust coiffed with fillet, draped right. Obverse inscription: FAVSTINA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Juno standing left holding sceptre in left hand; right arm extended with patera, peacock left. Reverse inscription: IVNO. Diameter: 19.0mm, Weight: 2.96gms, die axis: 12
